lines.say: Welcome to Class three. Daily Routine and the Present Simple Tense.
Rule one. The Present Simple is for things that happen regularly, not right now.

show.text: The Present Simple is for things that happen regularly, not right now.

lines.say: Rule two. Use do and does for questions and negatives.
